title: Too many missing features
body: There are a lot of missing Task List standard functions. I am using this for only few reasons - web app for desktop, task lists like bars - swith on/off, Task has two date fields - task date and deadline.
author: Andrisb7

title: Simple and effective
body: It has everything you need from a todo app and seamlessly integrates with Gmail and Google Calendar.
author: avisnakovs

title: Tasks are missing on google calendar iPad OS
body:
Hey
It will be great if you will add google tasks in google calendar app on Ipad and iPhone.
Also please add the ability to hide/unhide subtasks. I think that this app could have very big potential. Google tasks could go even further and become like Asana, to meet the project management needs and sync with calendar. Just do it :) we know, you can ! 
Thank you
